headline: US Hydrogen Energy Projects Stall Amid Funding Cuts and Weak Demand
summary: Development of US hydrogen fuel hubs has stalled amid faltering political support, funding cuts, and weak demand.
why: Hydrogen is a key alternative energy vector for the green energy transition, requiring significant capital expenditure and regulatory backing.

impacts.name: Hydrogen Energy Sector
impacts.why: Funding cuts and weak demand directly hinder the development of hydrogen fuel hubs in the United States.
